title: WebDesk Shopify App Project State Schema
description: Single source of truth for the flagship Shopify public App Store app project. Every agent reads this file at start of turn and writes at end. Atomic, locked, versioned. The orchestrator reads project.project_type here to scope KB loading (context-budget discipline) and never loads another project-type's KB. There are no integration_targets — this skill builds one public app, not middleware.

id.description: UUID v4 for the project. Generated by init-project.sh (uuid4). Distinct from the human-readable client_slug/name.

name.description: Human-readable project name, e.g. 'Rossy AI Shopify App'.

client_slug.description: kebab-case identifier used as the workspace folder name, e.g. 'rossy-ai'.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file conforms to.

project_type.description: Drives which project-type KB arm loads. Never load another project-type's KB. 'app-build' = initial build → first App Store launch; 'feature' = new-feature grooming → ship; 'maintenance' = bug tickets + health score; 'api-version-upgrade' = the quarterly Shopify API bump.

build_context.description: The one and only arm. This skill builds a single flagship Shopify public app — no second technology arm, no integration targets.

timezone.description: IANA timezone string (e.g. 'America/Toronto'). The operational clock for gate SLA timers, billing reconciliation windows, report boundaries, and displayed timestamps. Stored UTC, displayed local.

shopify.description: Shopify public-app configuration. Written at init-project and refined at G1.5. Drives whether G-PCD fires (protected_scopes) and how G-Schema is reviewed (data_ownership).

distribution.description: Public App Store distribution only. This skill does not build custom or custom-distribution apps.

api_version.description: Admin GraphQL API version pin, e.g. '2026-07'. Default 2026-07; confirmed per SOW. The api-version-upgrade project type bumps this. REST Admin API is prohibited.

scopes.description: Access scopes the app requests (least privilege). e.g. 'read_products', 'write_products'. Protected order/customer scopes (e.g. 'read_orders', 'read_customers') require G-PCD.

protected_scopes.description: True if `scopes` includes protected customer data (order/customer) scopes. When true, G-PCD fires — protected customer data access is a separate Shopify review requested BEFORE app submission.

app_pricing.description: Shopify App Pricing (recurring + usage), NOT the legacy Billing API. App Pricing has no usage cap, so the app must enforce its own spend limits and reconcile emitted usage events against the Historical API.

model.description: Billing model. 'usage' and 'recurring+usage' require a spend-limit guard + Historical-API reconciliation job.

self_enforced_spend_limit.description: True if a per-merchant spend-limit guard is implemented (mandatory for any usage model).

reconciliation.description: True if a Historical-API reconciliation job compares emitted App Events to the Historical event log and alerts on drift (mandatory for any usage model).

data_ownership.description: 'dedicated' (default) = the app owns a dedicated Postgres DB and its migrations. 'shared-saas' (the Rossy AI variant) = the app consumes the SaaS platform's shared DB, owns NO migrations, and reads super-admin global settings; G-Schema becomes a shared-data contract review.

jobs_ownership.description: 'app' (default) = background jobs run on the app's own host. 'saas' (tracks shared-saas data_ownership) = jobs run on the SaaS platform; they must still surface failures to the app's monitoring (G5.5). The app may ship no queue.

hosting.description: Hosting model, decided at G1.5. 'long-running' Node process or 'serverless'. Affects webhook delivery and cold-start behavior.

extensions.description: App extensions in scope (e.g. 'theme-app-extension'). Usually empty — the first flagship app is admin-embedded only.

built_for_shopify.description: True if targeting the Built-for-Shopify tier (the higher quality bar). Default true for the flagship.

host_target.description: Deployment target. Local-first by default (Shopify CLI dev loop); the long-running-vs-serverless decision is justified at G1.5.

data_sensitivity.description: Captured at G0. 'high' when the app touches protected customer data. Drives security baseline depth and minimum-use handling.

stage.description: Current lifecycle stage. 'grooming' (G0.5) is the default intake stage; 'protected-data-review' = awaiting external G-PCD; 'app-review' = G-Review readiness; 'submitted' = awaiting external G6 Shopify review.

current_gate.description: ID of the gate currently open or next to open, e.g. 'G1.5', 'G-Schema', 'G-PCD', 'G-Review', 'G4-sprint-2.1'.

assigned_team.description: Named humans. Used for self-approval checks (approver must differ from doer) and override authority.

tech_stack.description: Selected stack for this app, justified at the relevant gate. Defaults per CONVENTIONS §8 (verified 2026-08-17): React Router 7 + Polaris web components + App Bridge + PostgreSQL + Sequelize + Admin GraphQL. Agents read this and ask if a layer is missing rather than guessing.

framework.description: React Router 7 + @shopify/shopify-app-react-router. The Remix template is deprecated.

ui.description: Polaris web components (CDN) + latest App Bridge in <head> of every page. Polaris React is archived — never used.

orm.description: On the shared-saas data_ownership path the app owns NO migrations (the SaaS platform does).

session_storage.description: @shopify/shopify-app-session-storage-postgresql. No Redis unless justified at G1.5.

auth.description: Token exchange + managed installation. NO OAuth redirect.

admin_api.description: Admin GraphQL, pinned (see project.shopify.api_version). REST Admin API prohibited.

billing.description: Shopify App Pricing (recurring + usage). Not the legacy Billing API.

queue.description: Background jobs. 'none' if the app ships no queue (shared-saas path); 'app-host' if jobs run on the app's host; 'saas' if the SaaS platform owns them.

lock.description: Mutex for atomic writes. Prevents race conditions across agents writing project.json.

locked_by.description: Agent name or human ID holding the lock.

gates.description: One entry per gate event. Gate IDs are canonical per CONVENTIONS §4 / gate-format.md.

external.description: True for G-PCD and G6 — Shopify controls the turnaround; no internal SLA timer. The PM records the Partner-Dashboard submission and the Shopify decision in notes.

approver.description: Designated approver (email or role). 'shopify' for the external gates G-PCD and G6, with the Partner-Dashboard submission + Shopify decision recorded in notes.

ticket_id.description: Recorded at G1 (estimate→ticket) and on any RENEGOTIATE re-estimate. The audit anchor that change-requests re-estimate against.

budget.description: Token + hours budget. The orchestrator halts and writes HANDOFF.md at >90% of the context budget; never truncates silently.

token_cap.description: Hard cap on tokens for this project.

token_alert_threshold.description: Emit an alert when token_used crosses this.

hours_budget.description: Quoted/approved hours (from the G1 estimate ticket).

shared_data_contract.description: Present ONLY on the shared-saas data_ownership path (Rossy AI). Reference to the shared-data contract entry (conforms to integration-contract.schema.json, approved at G-Schema) describing which SaaS tables/settings the app reads and writes, migration ownership (SaaS side), and super-admin settings propagation. Null on the dedicated-DB path.

ref.description: Path to the contract file, e.g. 'shared-data-contract.md'.

status.description: No shared-DB read/write code may be written against a 'draft' contract.

rfcs.description: Change-request proposals (rfc-template.md). An accepted RFC may produce an ADR and may trigger a G1 RENEGOTIATE re-estimate.

ref.description: Path to the RFC file under rfcs/.

resulting_adr.description: ADR ID if the RFC produced one.

triggers_reestimate.description: True if accepting this RFC re-enters G1 for re-estimate.

health_score.description: Project Health Score snapshot. Conforms to health-score.schema.json. Baselined at M6 and tracked in maintenance.

rollup.description: Worst-of the five sub-ratings (a single RED forces RED).

runbooks_status.description: Presence/readiness of operational runbooks. All applicable must be 'present' before G5.5/G-Review.

webhook_replay.description: Re-deliver / dedupe webhooks safely (idempotency), including GDPR compliance webhooks.

redaction_jobs.description: Uninstall + customers/redact + shop/redact handling that ACTUALLY deletes data (on the shared-saas path, from the shared DB, coordinated with the SaaS platform).

billing_reconciliation.description: Historical-API reconciliation recovery. 'n/a' if the billing model has no usage component.

audit_log_path.description: Path to the append-only audit log (e.g. 'audit-log.jsonl'). The audit_log array below may mirror recent entries; the file is the durable record.

audit_log.description: Append-only log of every state-changing action.
